statement.notes: 1. Revenue mapped directly from the primary statement. 2. Total operating cost includes Cost of sales, Marketing and selling expenses, General and administrative expenses, and Other operating income and expenses (which is an expense). Income/(Loss) from joint ventures and associates is included as a positive component (income) of operating cost, as it is part of the operating profit calculation. 3. Net income mapped to 'Net profit, Group share'. 4. Taxes mapped directly from 'Income taxes'. 5. Interest expenses include 'Cost of net financial debt' and 'Interest on lease liabilities'. 'Other financial income and expenses' is excluded as it contains non-interest components like foreign exchange derivatives and fair value adjustments. 6. All values are in EUR millions as per the statement. Parentheses indicate negatives.
